subject.title: feat(ui): hold-to-record dictation on the composer mic button

question: Should hold-to-record dictation be enabled by default for existing web-composer users, with an opt-out setting, rather than introduced as an opt-in preference?
rationale: This is a new default interaction and persisted settings surface, so tests cannot determine the intended upgrade and discoverability policy.

options.title: Approve default-on after live proof
options.body: Keep the proposed default-on gesture because quick tap remains realtime Talk and users can explicitly opt out, but require configured-provider browser evidence before merge.

options.title: Ship as opt-in
options.body: Default the new preference off so existing composer microphone interaction remains unchanged until users enable dictation in Settings.

recommendation.title: Approve default-on after live proof
recommendation.body: Keep the proposed default-on gesture because quick tap remains realtime Talk and users can explicitly opt out, but require configured-provider browser evidence before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Authored the proposed UI interaction and its default preference; current-main area ownership was not available in the supplied history.
